title: Edu-Values: Towards Evaluating the Chinese Education Values of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to standard examination questions (multiple-choice, multi-modal, subjective analysis) derived from the Chinese National Teacher Certificate Examination, as well as using adversarial prompts designed to test the model's adherence to professional teaching ethics, student equality, and proper educational philosophy.

Assessing models using Chinese cultural literacy questions and traditional culture short-answer questions, and systematically comparing the performance of Chinese LLMs versus English LLMs to measure disparities in understanding culturally specific educational contexts.
